data_fields.name: hit_skill_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 added to both skills in the hit ratio

data_fields.name: hit_bonus_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 45 percentage points, attacker accuracy and defender defence

data_fields.name: parry_chance_divisor_aos
data_fields.donor_constant: parry skill / 800 for the AOS roll

data_fields.name: strength_damage_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: scalar 0.300 per point, threshold 100, offset 5.00, divided by 100

data_fields.name: anatomy_damage_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: scalar 0.500 per point, threshold 100, offset 5.00, divided by 100

data_fields.name: tactics_damage_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: scalar 0.625 per point, threshold 100, offset 6.25, divided by 100

data_fields.name: resist_divisor
data_fields.donor_constant: 10000 (damage x element share x (100 - resist), summed)

best_idea: A hit chance as a ratio of attacker to defender skill with a fixed offset and capped bonuses, plus a resist-weighted damage split with a minimum of one, both as pure functions the server runs once per swing.
decision_why: Take the ratio hit roll and the resist split, which give a testable server roll with explicit caps. Do not take the strength/anatomy/tactics damage ladder (no ruling covers stat-driven damage) or the percent-source stack as it stands; keep the parry and guard gates in row 3.
acceptance: Server test: equal skills and no bonuses give hit chance 0.5; attacker skill 120 against defender 100 gives 0.583; a bonus above 45 counts as 45; a landed hit never does less than 1 damage unless armour is ignored.
